result:
`ns build ios` succeeds and the app runs cleanly on the iOS Simulator. Implemented Phase 1 (App shell) per SPEC.md §3:

- **Home.vue** — title/subtitle, `Health` and `Transcribe` buttons navigating via `$navigateTo`.
- **Health.vue** — placeholder with exact status line, enabled `Request Access`, disabled `Log 500 Steps`, `Last 7 Days` header, `No data yet` empty state.
- **Transcribe.vue** — placeholder with exact status line, enabled `Request Access`, disabled `Transcribe Sample`, `No transcript yet` empty state.

Both feature screens get automatic native back navigation (iOS ActionBar back button) to Home. Verified visually via simulator screenshots that all labels match the spec exactly and forward/back navigation works. No other spec sections were implemented, and SPEC.md/spec-assets/ were left untouched.
